implementation_issues.description: construct_dd: method: Estimator for the repeated Eq. (1a) fits is not reported.
construct_dd: sample_size: The paper gives only a minimum of 20 firms per eligible industry-year group; aggregate fit count and each fit N are unreported.
construct_dd: variable_scaling.average_assets_timing: Exact timing of the average-assets denominator is unreported.
construct_dd/dv: Total current accruals: ΔCA−ΔCL−ΔCash+ΔSTDEBT (Compustat items 4, 5, 1 and 34), scaled by average assets in Eq. (1a); exact denominator timing is unreported.

construct_dd/iv_001: Cash flow from operations at t-1, computed as IBEX−TCA+DEPN and scaled by average assets; exact denominator timing is unreported. IBEX is income before extraordinary items (item 18); DEPN is depreciation and amortization expense (item 14).

construct_dd/iv_002: Cash flow from operations at t, computed as IBEX−TCA+DEPN and scaled by average assets; exact denominator timing is unreported. IBEX is income before extraordinary items (item 18); DEPN is depreciation and amortization expense (item 14).

construct_dd/iv_003: Cash flow from operations at t+1, computed as IBEX−TCA+DEPN and scaled by average assets; exact denominator timing is unreported. IBEX is income before extraordinary items (item 18); DEPN is depreciation and amortization expense (item 14).
construct_dd/iv_004: Change in revenues (Compustat item 12), scaled by average assets in Eq. (1a); exact denominator timing is unreported.
construct_dd/iv_005: Gross property, plant and equipment (Compustat item 7), scaled by average assets in Eq. (1a); exact denominator timing is unreported.
construct_dd/iv_006: Intercept coefficient multiplied by inverse average assets; this is a distinct RHS regressor, not an ordinary unscaled constant. Exact denominator timing is unreported.

implementation_issues.description: baseline_abacc2: sample_id: The supplied sample metadata contains a DD record only; the distinct ABACC² sample N is 99,643, so no mismatched sample_id is assigned.
construct_abacc: method: Estimator for the repeated Eq. (2) fits is not reported.
construct_abacc: sample_size: The paper gives only a minimum of 20 firms per eligible industry-year group; aggregate fit count and each fit N are unreported.
construct_abacc: variable_scaling.average_assets_timing: Exact timing of the average-assets denominator is unreported.
construct_abacc/dv: Total accruals computed as TCA−DEPN; TCA is ΔCA−ΔCL−ΔCash+ΔSTDEBT. TA is scaled by average assets in Eq. (2); exact denominator timing is unreported.
construct_abacc/iv_001: Change in revenues (Compustat item 12) minus change in accounts receivable (item 2), scaled by average assets; exact denominator timing is unreported.
construct_abacc/iv_002: Gross property, plant and equipment (Compustat item 7), scaled by average assets; exact denominator timing is unreported.
construct_abacc/iv_004: Intercept coefficient multiplied by inverse average assets; this is a distinct RHS regressor, not an ordinary unscaled constant. Exact denominator timing is unreported.
construct_ff3_daily: method: Estimator for the daily factor regression is not reported.
construct_ff3_daily: sample_size: Exact daily observation count and fit window are unreported.
construct_ff3_daily: independent_variables[2].definition: Market beta factor(s) are named but not operationally defined.
Paper-specific issue: The DD and ABACC² support equations do not state the exact average-assets denominator dates.
Paper-specific issue: The firm-level daily factor-regression window and raw-versus-excess return convention are unreported.
Paper-specific issue: The paper defines pre-1978 FREV2A as zero but does not specify early-year NANAL coding; IBES coverage for that control is unresolved.
Paper-specific issue: 13F holdings need security links, quarterly-to-fiscal-year aggregation and a denominator choice; source specifications are incomplete.
Paper-specific issue: Current CRSP, Compustat, IBES, 13F and factor vintages differ from the study-era inputs; historical population coverage and identifier links are unconfirmed.
